# Launching a new warehouse is a major milestone, but what makes me most proud is the incredible teamwork behind it. · 2026-08-11T00:00:00+00:00

Launching a new warehouse is a major milestone, but what makes me most proud is the incredible teamwork behind it.

Today, we celebrate the opening of ID Logistics in Rugby; a significant investment in our future, our customers, and our continued growth. Facilities and infrastructure are important, but the real success story is the people who made it happen.

Over just 11 weeks, colleagues from across the business have come together with a shared goal; rolling up their sleeves, supporting one another, and demonstrating the commitment, collaboration and determination that define our culture. From planning and preparation to execution, every team and every individual played a part in making this launch happen on schedule.

Seeing so many people step outside their day-to-day roles to support the project has been truly inspiring. It is a powerful reminder that when we work together as one team, we can achieve extraordinary things.

# Latest Bleckmann DC in Lutterworth celebrates going live

 23 July 2026 

Bleckmann, a specialist in supply chain management for fashion and lifestyle brands, is celebrating the go-live of its latest mega distribution centre (DC) in Lutterworth. In less than four months, the new warehouse has been fully prepared for operations. This clearly demonstrates Bleckmann’s speed and flexibility, which enable the company to scale up. 

The warehouse, located in the Midlands’ ‘Golden Triangle’, is suitable for categories such as beauty, hair care, sports and accessories, as well as fashion clothing.

The opening of the DC, which covers 761,932 square feet (70,786 square metres), marks a significant milestone for Bleckmann in the further expansion of its lifestyle logistics offering. With the successful go-live, a key milestone has been reached, and the company is ready to operate at full capacity.

# Ocado to open 55,000 sq ft automated fulfilment centre in Stoke-on-Trent

22 July, 2026 | by Angela Beevers

Ocado Group is to open a 55,000 square foot automated customer fulfilment centre (CFC) in Stoke-on-Trent in a move that is expected to create hundreds of jobs.

The company has taken the final unit at Indurent Park Stoke Central, a 530,000 square foot industrial and logistics space on the 300-acre Festival Park development in the city.

Under the agreement, Ocado will install its latest technology with the aim of going live in FY28. The site will be equipped with Ocado’s Re:Imagined technology suite, including the 600 Series bot, On-Grid Robotic Pick, and a fully automated freezer.

Ocado said it will transfer its existing online order volumes into the CFC, which is expected to go live using just over half of its design capacity.

## Savers to open new Northampton distribution centre

27th August 2026

Yasmeen Louis

Savers is to open a new distribution centre in Northampton in late 2026, as it invests in additional capacity to support the retailer’s growth.

The site will be managed by GXO, which has worked with Savers for more than 25 years, and is expected to create up to 275 local jobs.

The new facility will provide additional capacity and flexibility across the retailer’s distribution network as the retailer progresses with an ambitious store-opening programme over the next three years.

Savers’ existing distribution centre will remain operational and continue to support stores and customers.

Savers supply chain director Mark Peaker said: “This new distribution centre is an important step in supporting our continued growth.

“With an ambitious store opening programme over the next three years, it strengthens our network and gives us the additional capacity and flexibility we need for the future, helping us serve our stores and customers even more effectively.

# Family food business opens landmark distribution centre as employee celebrates 50 years of service

31 Jul 2026

Bramble Foods, a family-owned manufacturer and distributor of fine foods, is set to create new jobs after officially moving into a major new base in Market Harborough – marking a significant milestone in the company’s growth and its long-term commitment to the county.

The business has expanded into Lancaster House, a purpose-built 67,000 sq. ft distribution centre at Airfield Business Park, Market Harborough, built by Leicestershire County Council.

The state-of-the-art facility becomes Bramble Foods’ main national distribution hub, significantly increasing warehousing and distribution capacity while supporting the company’s expanding portfolio of premium food brands and growing customer base across the UK.

Employing around 300 people, LDC-backed Bramble Group, which includes Whitakers Chocolates, The Bay Tree and Lings, expects Lancaster House to support continued business growth with the potential to increase its workforce to 350 employees over the coming years

# Bleckmann inaugura su nuevo centro de distribución en Lutterworth

 23 julio 2026 

Bleckmann, especialista en gestión de la cadena de suministro para marcas de moda y lifestyle, celebra el inicio de operaciones de su nuevo megacentro de distribución en Lutterworth. En menos de cuatro meses, el nuevo almacén ha quedado totalmente preparado para arrancar su actividad. Esto demuestra claramente la rapidez y flexibilidad de Bleckmann, lo que permite a la compañía escalar sus operaciones. 

El centro de distribución, ubicado en el estratégico «Golden Triangle» de las Midlands británicas, es idóneo para categorías como belleza, cuidado capilar, deporte y accesorios, además de la moda textil.

La apertura de este centro, que abarca más de 70.000 metros cuadrados, marca un hito importante para Bleckmann en la continua expansión de su oferta logística para el sector lifestyle. Con esta exitosa puesta en marcha, se alcanza un objetivo clave y la empresa ya está lista para operar a pleno rendimiento.

 By Jeff Berman · September 2, 2026 

 

San Francisco-based freight forwarding and customs brokerage services provider Flexport this week said that it has rolled out its first international fulfillment service operations, in in Mississauga, Canada and Manchester, England, respectively.

Flexport officials said that bringing international fulfillment services to these locales extends the company’s end-to-end logistics network into markets where its customers already sell. What’s more, it added that “Canada and the United Kingdom rank among the most attractive markets in the world to sell into, and many brands serve them from a warehouse in another country.”
